title: Allgemeinverfügungen erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Mitte

extraction.summaryEn: Police issued temporary general orders in Mitte restricting assemblies and carrying weapons and knives around the Ritz Carlton, Schloss Bellevue and the Chancellery during a state visit, from 29 to 30 March 2026. The restrictions apply in fixed zones and at set times.
